ask: When two people give the same passage to different translators offline, should the last one win, or should both translators see it?
problem: Bezily's group wants a coordinator to give passages, a chapter or a book to one translator, who then sees them in My work. The app cannot do this in bulk today.
found: A coordinator can already ask one person to record one passage. Both asks stay open, so both people see it. Missing: picking many passages, seeing who has each, and moving it.
changed: Nothing yet. I wrote three options with a picture each. The code stays as it is until you answer.
why: Option 1 gives one clear owner. Option 2 is cheapest: no new record type. Option 3 loses no work but needs a coordinator to settle each clash.
touches: Option 1 and option 3 add a new kind of record, so they need a server change and a new entry in the decision log. Option 2 needs neither. All three leave the audio prefetch work (LAN-19) able to use the list of passages given to a person.

pictures.label: Option 2: reuse asks, both see it
Option 3: both see it until a coordinator picks

options.label: Last one wins
options.result: One owner per passage. The later assignment replaces the earlier one. The first translator is told it moved.

options.label: Both see it, using today's asks
options.result: Bulk picking on top of the existing ask to record. Both translators see the passage. The first to record closes it for the other.

options.label: Both see it, coordinator settles
options.result: A new assignment record. A clash shows as two people on one passage until a coordinator keeps one.
